consent.1: Tubuuza ebibuuzo ebyangu. Ogenda kunyiga bunyiza.
consent.2: Eby'okuddamu byo bituyamba okukuwa ebintu by'osobola okugezaako.
consent.3: Tewali linnya wadde nnamba ya ssimu. Bw'omala okukkiriza, tubala abatuukirira nga tewali mannya (si ku bali wansi w'emyaka 18). Bw'oggulawo okujjukizibwa, tutereka koodi ya ssimu yo. Yimirira buli kiseera.

result.rough: Eby'okuddamu byo byali bya mangu oba byonna bifaanagana, noolwekyo kino kya kuteebereza. Ddamu ogezeeko oluvannyuma.
q.c002: Nga mmaze okubeera n'abantu bangi, nkoowa era njagala emirembe.
q.c003: Nga mmaze okubeera n'abantu bangi, mpulira nga nnina amaanyi.
q.c004: Nsobola okutuula nzekka essaawa nnyingi nga nkola ekintu kimu.
q.c005: Njagala okusekereza abantu oba okutegeeza emboozi.
q.c006: Njagala okubala ssente n'okuwandiika ebitabo by'ensimbi.
q.c007: Njagala okuteekateeka olunaku lwange nga terunnatandika.
q.c008: Nsanyukira okuyigiriza omuntu engeri y'okukolamu ekintu.
q.c010: Njagala okukolera ebweru, mu njuba oba mu nkuba.
q.c011: Njagala okukuba ebifaananyi, ennyimba, oba okufuula ebintu ebirungi.
q.c013: Njagala okulima ebimera oba okulabirira ebisolo.
q.c015: Njagala okuyiga ebintu ebipya mu vidiyo oba ebitabo.
q.c016: Njagala okukuba ebifaananyi oba okukola vidiyo.
q.c018: Abantu bajja gye ndi emirundi mingi okunsaba amagezi.
q.c020: Njagala ekirowoozo ky'okutandika bizinensi yange entono.
q.c021: Njagala ebiwandiiko n'empapula nga bitegekeddwa bulungi era nga ntuufu.
q.c022: Njagala okukebera obutono okutuusa buli kimu lwe kiba kituufu.
q.c023: Njagala ennaku lwe simanyi kigenda kubaawo.
q.c024: Nkola bulungi nga waliwo emirimu mingi era egy'amangu.
q.c025: Nkola bulungi nga nsobola okukola mpola era mu mirembe.
q.c026: Njagala okutambuza omubiri gwange olunaku lwonna.
q.c027: Njagala okukola nga ntudde awatali kutambula nnyo.
q.c028: Nsinga kwagala okukolera munda mu kisenge ekitereevu.
q.c029: Njagala okugezaako ebintu ebipya, ne bwe nnyinza okulemererwa.
q.c030: Njagala ensimbi zange zibeere nga ntebenkevu era zeezimu buli mwezi.
q.c031: Njagala abantu bangi balabe kye nkola.
q.c032: Njagala okukola emirimu emirungi mu kasirise, wala n'ekibiina ky'abantu.
q.c034: Nsinga kwagala okukola mu kibiina nga waliwo omukulembeze.
q.c035: Njagala nze nsalewo engeri gye nkolamu omulimu gwange.
q.c036: Njagala okuba omukugu ddala mu kintu kimu.
q.c037: Kikulu gye ndi omulimu gwange okuyamba abalala.
q.c040: Njagala okulongoosa obulamu mu kyalo kyange oba mu kibuga kyange.

q.d001: Nsobola okukolera mu kifo ekirimu amasoso olunaku lwonna.
q.d003: Nsobola okwogera n'abantu be simanyi olunaku lwonna.
q.d004: Nsobola okukola mu njuba ne mu nkuba.
q.d005: Nsobola okutambula oba okwebaka wala n'awaka.

j.fix.NO_TIME: Kola eddakiika 10 zokka leero. N'eddakiika 10 zibalibwa.
j.fix.NO_DATA: Kozesa leediyo, ekitabo ky'eddiini, oba buuza omuntu ali okumpi. Tewali yintaneeti yeetaagisa.
j.fix.FORGOT: Londa essaawa emu buli lunaku era gitegeeze mukwano gwo.
j.fix.AFRAID: Kikole ne mukwano gwo. Tandika n'ekitundu ekisinga obutono.
j.quiet: Engeri ey'emirembe: weereza obubaka mu kifo ky'okwogera.
j.talker: Engeri y'omwogezi: kikole maaso ku maaso n'abantu 3.
j.finished2: Ekiddako: kiddemu, kola ebisingawo, era saba omulimu omutono ddala.
step.journalism.0: Wulira amawulire amakulu ku leediyo. Weebuuze: omusasi yabuuza ki olubereberye?
step.journalism.1: Tegeeza ekintu ekyaliwo mu kyalo kyo mu sentensi 5.
step.journalism.2: Wandiika lipoota y'eddoboozi eya sekondi 60 ku kizibu ky'omu kitundu ekituufu.
step.journalism.3: Weereza lipoota yo eri abantu 5. Babuuze: yategeerekeka?
step.journalism.4: Kwatagana n'omusasi omu ow'omu kitundu. Mubuuze yafuna atya emboozi ye esooka.
step.repair.0: Tunuulira omuntu ng'addaabiriza essimu oba leediyo. Mubuuze: yasooka kukebera ki?
step.repair.1: Sumulula ekyuma ekikadde ekyabula era tuuma buli kitundu ky'olaba.
step.repair.2: Ddaabiriza ekizibu ekitono: obutambi obuli ku bbali, ekituli kya chaaja ekyonoonese, oba waya.
step.repair.3: Laga abantu 3 kye wadaabiriza. Babuuze: mwandisasudde ku kino?
step.repair.4: Genda mu dduuka erimu abaddaabiriza. Buuza kye baali baagala okumanya mu kusooka.
step.tailoring.0: Tunuulira engoye 3 n'obwegendereza. Laba engeri enkwaso n'ensonda gye zikoleddwa.
step.tailoring.1: Koppa enkwaso emu eyangu ku lugoye olukadde.
step.tailoring.2: Tunga ekintu ekitono: ensawo, enkoofiira, oba ekiwaayi.
step.tailoring.4: Yogera n'omutunzi w'engoye. Mubuuze yafuna atya omuguzi we asooka.
step.farming.0: Tambula mu nnimiro oba mu lusuku. Laba ekirima obulungi n'ekitalima.
step.farming.1: Lima ensigo 5 oba ebimera 5 nga omulimi omulungi bw'akola.
step.farming.2: Labirira ekitundu ky'ennimiro ekitono okumala wiiki emu. Wandiika by'olaba.
step.farming.3: Laga muliraanwa wo omulimi ennimiro yo. Mubuuze yandikoze ki.
step.farming.4: Buuza omulimi oba ekibiina ky'abalimi bwe batunda ebirime byabwe.
step.cooking.0: Tunuulira omuntu ng'afumba emmere. Laba ennyingo, obudde, n'obuwoomi.
step.cooking.1: Fumba emmere y'emu ggwe kennyini awaka.
step.cooking.2: Fumbira abantu 2 era okyuse ekintu kimu ggwe kennyini.
step.cooking.3: Babuuze: kiki ekyali ekirungi, era kiki ekitaali kirungi?
step.cooking.4: Buuza omufumbi oba omugabi w'emmere ow'omu kitundu bw'atereka emiwendo gy'emmere ye.
step.hair.0: Tunuulira omusazi w'enviiri ng'akola. Laba engeri gy'akwata ebikozesebwa n'engeri gy'ayogeramu.
step.hair.1: Koppa engeri y'okuluka eyangu ku mukwano gwo oba ku ggwe wennyini.
step.hair.2: Kola engeri emu ennyangu okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero.
step.hair.3: Laga abantu 3 ekivudde mu kukola kwo. Babuuze kye baagala.
step.hair.4: Buuza nnannyini saloon omutandisi bw'afuna omuguzi asooka.
step.teaching.0: Tunuulira omusomesa omulungi. Laba engeri gy'annyonnyolamu ekirowoozo ekizibu.
step.teaching.1: Nnyonnyola ekintu ky'omanyi mu ddoboozi mu bigambo ebyangu.
step.teaching.2: Yigiriza omwana oba mukwano gwo ekintu ekitono mu ddakiika 10.
step.teaching.4: Buuza omusomesa yafuna atya abayizi be abasooka.
step.sales.0: Tunuulira omutunzi omulungi. Laba engeri gy'asaabamu n'engeri gy'amaliriza okutunda.
step.sales.1: Koppa engeri gy'asaabamu ng'oyogera n'omuntu leero.
step.sales.2: Tunda oba kyusa ekintu ekitono ne omuntu gw'omanyi.
step.sales.3: Buuza abantu 3: lwaki mwagula, oba lwaki temwagula?
step.sales.4: Buuza nnannyini dduuka afuna atya abaguzi buli lunaku.
step.bookkeeping.0: Tunuulira ekitabo ky'eddduuka. Laba ekiwandiikibwa buli lunaku.
step.bookkeeping.1: Koppa olunaku olumu olw'ebyatundibwa mu lukalala olulongoofu.
step.bookkeeping.2: Wandiika buli lunaku ensimbi zo wennyini okumala ennaku 3.
step.bookkeeping.3: Laga omuntu olukalala lwo. Mubuuze: lwategeerekeka?
step.bookkeeping.4: Buuza nnannyini dduuka oba yeetaaga obuyambi mu kuwandiika ebitabo bye.
step.webapp.0: Tunuulira vidiyo emu ennyimpi ku ngeri webusaayiti gye ekolebwamu.
step.webapp.1: Koppa olupapula olutono ennyo: omutwe, ekifaananyi, n'akabonero kamu.
step.webapp.2: Kola webusaayiti ey'olupapula olumu ku kintu ky'oyagala.
step.webapp.4: Weereza obubaka eri omukozi wa pulogulaamu. Mubuuze yatandika atya.
step.media.0: Tunuulira vidiyo oba bipande 3 by'oyagala. Laba omusana n'langi.
step.media.1: Koppa ekifaananyi kimu oba ekipande kimu nga bw'osobola okusinga.
step.media.2: Kola ekifaananyi, vidiyo ennyimpi, oba ekipande kyo wennyini.
step.media.3: Kiraze abantu 5. Babuuze ekitundu kye baagala.
step.media.4: Buuza omukubi w'ebifaananyi oba omukozi wa dizayini ow'omu kitundu bw'afuna abaguzi.
step.tourism.0: Wulira omulambuzi oba tunuulira vidiyo y'olugendo. Laba engeri gy'ategeezaamu emboozi.
step.tourism.1: Tegeeza omugenyi emboozi ey'ekifo ky'omanyi mu sentensi 5.
step.tourism.2: Teekateeka olugendo lw'ebigere olw'eddakiika 30 olw'okulaga ekitundu kyo.
step.tourism.4: Yogera n'omulambuzi w'omu kitundu oba omukozi wa hoteeri. Mubuuze yatandika atya.
step.interpreting.0: Wulira amawulire mu lulimi lumu. Laba ebigambo by'omanyi mu nnimi zombi.
step.interpreting.1: Yogera sentensi emu ennyimpi mu nnimi bbiri.
step.interpreting.2: Vvuunula mu ddoboozi akatabo akatono oba obubaka.
step.interpreting.3: Buuza mukwano gwo amanyi ennimi zombi: kituufu?
step.interpreting.4: Buuza omuvvuunuzi yafuna atya omulimu gwe ogusooka.
step.construction.0: Tunuulira abazimbi oba abaweldinga mu kifo ekituufu. Laba ennyingo y'omulimu.
step.construction.1: Koppa omulimu gumu omwangu n'omuyambi: okupima, okuteekako akabonero, oba okusala.
step.construction.2: Kola ekintu ekitono: essaawa, entebe, oba ekiwanirizo.
step.construction.4: Buuza omuzimbi oba nnannyini kifo ky'emirimu oba osobola okumuyamba olunaku lumu.
step.driving.0: Tunuulira omuvuzi ng'akola. Laba engeri gy'ateekateekamu ekkubo.
step.driving.1: Yiga enguudo z'ekitundu kyo. Kuba maapu ennyangu ng'ova mu mutwe.
step.driving.2: Teekateeka ekkubo erisinga obulungi ery'ennaku 3 mu kibuga.
step.driving.3: Laga omuvuzi enteekateeka yo. Mubuuze ekibulamu.
step.driving.4: Buuza omuvuzi omutandisi bw'afuna omulimu mu ngeri ey'obukuumi.
remind.hint: Si buteetaavu. Ekijjukizo ekimu ekimpi bw'olinda ennaku 2. Osobola okuyimirira ekiseera kyonna.
remind.denied: Okumanyisa kuziyiziddwa. Kukkirize mu nteekateeka za brawuza.
remind.unsupported: Essimu eno oba brawuza eno tesobola kulaga bijjukizo.
remind.error: Tekisobose kuggulawo bijjukizo. Ddamu ogezeeko oluvannyuma.
remind.ios: Ku iPhone: nyiga Share, olwo Add to Home Screen, olwo ggulawo Cooker okuva ku Home Screen okufuna ebijjukizo.
j.minor: Oli wa wansi w'emyaka 18? Genda n'omuzadde, omusomesa oba omuntu omukulu gw'weesiga. Tosisinkana muntu gw'otomanyi ng'oli wekka.
j.h.NO_DATA: Tolina yintaneeti? Kozesa leediyo, ekitabo oba buuza omuntu ali okumpi.
j.h.SCHOOL: Kikole oluvannyuma lw'essomero oba ku wikendi.
q.c041: Njagala omuntu ang'ambulire bulungi engeri y'okukolamu omulimu gwange.
q.c042: Njagala okugezaako ebintu bingi okusinga okukugu mu kimu.
q.c043: Mu bungi nkola olw'ebyetaago byange, si lwa balala.
q.c044: Tekimbeeraamu nsonga ssente bwe zeeyongera oba okukendeera.
q.c046: Obulamu bwange bunkwatako okusinga obw'ekibuga kyange.
about: Cooker ekuyamba okuzuula ebitone n'ebyo by'oyagala. Tukukulembera mu madaala amatono, era okujjukizibwa kujja mangu, olyoke obituukeko.
